content.title: NTN 6304 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 20mm Bore x 52mm OD x 15mm Width
content.short_description: NTN 6304 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 20 mm bore, 52 mm OD, and 15 mm width. Dynamic load rating 15.9 kN, static load rating 7.88 kN.
content.long_description:
The NTN 6304 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing in an open configuration, meaning it has no integral seals or shields on either side. This design allows for direct access to the internals for relubrication and is typically selected where the operating environment is controlled or where the application already incorporates external sealing.

Dimensionally, the 6304 has a 20 mm bore diameter, 52 mm outer diameter, and 15 mm width, placing it in the standard 03 series of metric ball bearings. It carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 15.9 kN, which defines the constant load the bearing can theoretically endure for one million revolutions, and a static load rating (C0) of 7.88 kN, indicating the load limit for permanent deformation under non-rotating or very low-speed conditions.

This bearing is suitable for radial and light axial loads in general industrial machinery, motors, pumps, gearboxes, and similar rotating equipment where the 20 x 52 x 15 mm envelope is specified. Since the bearing is open, users should plan for appropriate housing seals or shields if contamination control is required.
